summary: One call the model made to a tool: its name, what it was asked and where it is, opening to the input and the output.

props.name: summary
props.description: What it was asked, in a few words, beside the name.

props.name: state
props.description: Where it is: running, done or failed.

props.name: input
props.description: What it was given, shown when the card is open.

props.name: output
props.description: What it gave back, or the error, shown when the card is open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open on its input and output at the start.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the card. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
